=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory.py:955-1428 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The PR deletes the validation-history, operator-bypass-audit, and revalidate-events CLI handlers and related helpers from the AI memory CLI.
  WHY: Existing workflow/bootstrap callers and tests still rely on these subcommands, so removing them breaks the public command surface with argparse and command-not-found failures.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:581-676 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The PR deletes the supporting library functions, normalizers, path builders, validators, and schema constants for the removed memory command groups.
  WHY: The CLI and shell wrappers still expect these helpers, so deleting them breaks imports and the backing implementation needed by the removed commands.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:147-282 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The PR deletes the shell wrappers for validation-history, operator-bypass-audit, and revalidate-events.
  WHY: Any caller that sources memory_helpers.sh and invokes those helpers will now fail immediately with missing-command errors.
- scripts/ai_memory.py:77-83 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_require_positive_int` no longer wraps `_safe_int` ValueError in `MemoryValidationError`.
  WHY: Non-numeric input now escapes as a raw ValueError, breaking the expected validation exception contract for callers that handle `MemoryValidationError`.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:563-568 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_validate_positive_int_field` no longer rejects boolean values before coercion.
  WHY: Because `bool` is a subclass of `int`, True/False now silently coerce to 1/0 instead of being rejected as invalid input.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:45-50 and 85-90 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:harness-broken` label definition was removed from the helper catalogs.
  WHY: `ensure_label_exists "ai:harness-broken"` in the poller now falls back to generic metadata, so the label is created and reconciled with the wrong color/description.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:45-50 and 85-90 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:force-merge` and `ai:integration-backpressure` label entries were removed from the helper catalogs.
  WHY: Those canonical labels now fall back to generic defaults in any path that recreates them, silently degrading label fidelity and leaving the helper registry out of sync.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5880-5914 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When `gh run view` fails or yields no usable `outputs.raw_status`, the poller falls back to brittle text-pattern inference for harness errors.
  WHY: A real harness failure can be misclassified as an ordinary validation failure, which burns recovery budget and treats infrastructure defects as app regressions.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6030-6075 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new harness_error state updates use a non-atomic read-modify-write jq/mv flow.
  WHY: Overlapping poll/revalidate/self-heal writes can clobber each other and leave validation counters or fingerprint fields inconsistent.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10602-10616 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The validating poll loop now makes an extra `gh run view` API call every cycle.
  WHY: This increases GitHub API usage on every 5-minute tick and can accelerate rate-limit pressure for long-running validating projects.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/ai_memory.py:79-83 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_require_positive_int` no longer catches `ValueError` from `_safe_int` and re-raises `MemoryValidationError`.
  WHY: Non-numeric input now escapes as an unhandled ValueError, breaking callers that rely on the validation exception contract.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:563-566 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_validate_positive_int_field` no longer rejects booleans before coercion.
  WHY: True/False now pass through `int()` as 1/0, weakening the validation contract and breaking the existing boolean-rejection test.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:45-50 and 85-90 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `ai:harness-broken` was removed from both label catalog arrays.
  WHY: The poller still calls `ensure_label_exists "ai:harness-broken"`, so the label is now created with fallback metadata instead of the authoritative color/description.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6038-6048 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The harness_error state mutation uses a non-atomic jq read-modify-write cycle.
  WHY: Concurrent `/revalidate` or overlapping poll ticks can clobber each other and leave validation status and fingerprint counters inconsistent.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5880-5914 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `gh run view` failures or missing `outputs.raw_status` force brittle text-pattern inference for harness errors.
  WHY: If the wording does not match the regex fallback, a real harness error is misclassified as a normal validation failure and burns recovery budget.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5888-5894 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A purged or invalid run ID silently falls back to `{}` with no warning.
  WHY: The harness-error signal is lost and the same brittle text fallback path is used without any observability.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10606-10608 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The validating poll loop now invokes `get_last_validation_run_info` on every cycle.
  WHY: Each validating tick adds an extra GitHub API call, increasing shared rate-limit usage over long validation runs.
- scripts/ai_memory.py:955-1428; scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:581-676; scripts/memory_helpers.sh:147-282 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PR removes the validation-history, operator-bypass-audit, and revalidate-events command groups and their backing helpers.
  WHY: Existing tests and callers still import/invoke these commands, so the deletion breaks the public memory CLI/shell surface and will fail automation.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:48-50 and 88-90 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ai:force-merge` and `ai:integration-backpressure` were also removed from the label catalog arrays.
  WHY: These labels will now be recreated with generic defaults instead of their documented metadata, causing silent degradation for any code that relies on the helper catalogs.
- Requirement: "Apply/remove ai:harness-broken appropriately"
  Expected change site: scripts/label_helpers.sh — the `_AI_LABEL_COLORS` and `_AI_LABEL_DESCS` arrays should retain the `ai:harness-broken` entry with its intended color `e11d48` and description `Validation harness is broken and requires manual repair before automated validation can continue`
  Evidence of absence: The diff for `scripts/label_helpers.sh` shows `ai:harness-broken` was removed from both arrays (lines 48 and 88 in the old numbering). The poller code at `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` line ~6062 calls `ensure_label_exists "ai:harness-broken"` which will now create the label with generic fallback metadata ins
